data.gender_notes: Habaq is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Habaq is a name derived from the Arabic word 'habqa' which means 'green shoot' or 'bud'. It symbolizes the beginning of new life, growth, and renewal. This name is mentioned in the Hadith and is considered an honorable and blessed name in Islam. The name Habaq carries the meaning “Green shoot, bud, tender plant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Habaq usually hope their child will grow to embody green shoot, bud, tender plant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
